reels.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses 'Egocentric World Models' for multi-agent systems, which has a high audience velocity multiplier (1.26x) and fits perfectly with 3b1b-style visual storytelling of shared environments and agent interaction dynamics.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do AI agents 'see' each other when they share the same workspace?
